title: Helmet of Smiting

sources.title: Bolstering Smite
markers: | description = When you apply a condition with one of your Smite spells, you gain [[Temporary Hit Points]] equal to your [[Charisma|Charisma modifier]].

summary: Gain +1 Constitution saves. When a Smite spell applies a condition, gain temporary HP equal to your Charisma modifier.

fields.Base value: 115 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Bolstering Smite: Applying a condition with Banishing, Blinding, Branding, Searing, or Wrathful Smite grants temporary HP equal to Charisma modifier for 2 turns. Thunderous and Staggering Smite do not qualify. The source reports that any Frightened application can qualify, and other temporary HP can override the bonus even when lower.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
